title: 013 神秘女子014 天杀的贼这是朕的地啊
content_zh:
“尔等大庭广众下，吵吵嚷嚷什么呢？”
就在张泱准备一金砖拍飞沈知的时候，有女声从不远处传来。红名守兵冲来人抱拳行礼，凑近前悄声解释缘由。女子颤了颤眼睫，余光斜视过来，尔后才颔首低语什么。
沈知敏锐发现刚才还想杀人的张泱突然卸掉了力道，虽不知缘故却也舒了口气。眼下要是闹大，二人怕是连逃的机会都没有了。
女子内着青绿长裙，外披异色团花圆领大衣，脸颊虚胖，瞧着有些福态，但奇怪的是她气色不佳，头上顶着“神秘女子”称号。
这些都不是张泱最好奇的。
她好奇的是对方的名字居然是绿色的。
是的，在这红名PC、黄名PC到处跑的家园支线地图，她还是头一次碰见一见面就是绿名的PC。关键是只有女子绿名也就罢了，可偏偏在女子出现后，原先红名的守卫也诡异变成绿名。绿名友好，这意味着张泱在不动用特殊手段下无法攻击他们。
她干脆收起金砖。
女子笑吟吟问：“是沈三郎吗？”
张泱偏首看了看沈知，往后退了一步。
沈知抿着唇，不作回答。
“你可以不承认，不过你相貌跟你大哥那般相似，我想认错也难。”说完，女子冲一众守卫吩咐道，“各自去吧，一场误会。”
守卫神色为难：“上面问责下来……”
“若问责下来就说我带走了。”
听到这句话，守卫这才抱拳让行。
沈知心中揣着一肚子的疑惑，在他记忆中似乎没有这个女子的痕迹，大哥也不曾跟他提过。他一直憋着，直到入了城内一处民宅，女子解下披在肩头的大衣，他才出声。
“你认识我大哥？”
“我与沈大郎当过两年同窗。”
张泱不懂这句话的含金量，可沈知明白。
在这个世界，读书的门槛高得惊人，也就世家出身能轻松承担，寒门子弟或者平民百姓想要求学是难之又难。女子若无惊人天赋或是丰厚家底，也没可能跟他兄长同窗。

“坐吧，可有吓着？”
女子友善态度让沈知有些不自在。
“冒昧一问，天弁是什么情况？”沈知更好奇的是眼前这位自称跟兄长同窗两年的女子，又是什么身份？什么阵营？什么立场？
女子道：“你猜？”
沈知：“……”
见少年露出隐约的愠色，女子笑道：“你这反应跟你兄长真相似啊，只是想逗逗你而已。天弁治所有我们安插的内应，没费什么功夫就开城拿下了，入城后相安无事。”
沈知担心的画面没发生。
“也就是说，你跟叛军是一伙的？”
女子不乐意听到这个词，给自己倒了一杯茶水：“年轻人火气别这么大，你说，什么是叛军？什么又是王师？王室无道，诸子昏聩，闹得上下鸡飞狗跳，民不聊生……”
“说破天你们也是乱臣贼子。”
沈知可不吃女子这一套。
他有自己的评判标准。
content_en:
"You are in public, what are you making such a fuss about?"
Just when Zhang Yang was about to hit Shen Zhi with a gold brick, a female voice came from not far away. The red-named guard rushed towards the man and clasped his fists in salute. He came closer and explained the reason in a low voice. The woman trembled her eyelashes, glanced sideways from the corner of her eye, and then nodded and whispered something.
Shen Zhi keenly noticed that Zhang Yang, who had just wanted to kill someone, suddenly lost his strength. Although he didn't know the reason, he breathed a sigh of relief. If things get serious now, the two of them may not even have a chance to escape.
The woman was wearing a long green skirt and a round-necked coat with different colors and flowers on the outside. Her cheeks were plump and plump. She looked a little blessed, but the strange thing was that her complexion was not good, and she had the title of "Mysterious Woman" on her head.
These are not what Zhang Yang is most curious about.
What she was curious about was that the other person's name was actually green.
Yes, in this home branch map where red-named PCs and yellow-named PCs ran around, this was the first time she met a green-named PC. The key is that it is only a woman with a green name, but after the woman appeared, the guard with a red name also strangely changed to a green name. The green name is friendly, which means that Zhang Yang cannot attack them without using special means.
She simply put away the gold bricks.
The woman smiled and asked, "Is it Shen Sanlang?"
Zhang Yang turned his head to look at Shen Zhi and took a step back.
Shen Zhi pursed his lips and did not answer.
"You don't have to admit it, but you look so similar to your elder brother. I think it's hard to admit my mistake." After saying that, the woman told the guards, "Let's go our separate ways. It's just a misunderstanding."
The guard looked troubled: "I'll be accountable from above..."
"If you are held accountable, say I took him away."
After hearing these words, the guard clasped his fists and gave way.
Shen Zhi was full of doubts in his heart. There seemed to be no trace of this woman in his memory, and his eldest brother had never mentioned it to him. He kept holding it in until he entered a house in the city and the woman took off the coat draped around her shoulders, and then he said nothing.
"Do you know my elder brother?"
"I have been classmates with Shen Dalang for two years."
Zhang Yang didn't understand the value of this sentence, but Shen Zhi understood it.
In this world, the threshold for studying is astonishingly high. Only those from aristocratic families can easily afford it. It is very difficult for children from poor families or ordinary people to study. If a woman doesn't have amazing talents or a rich family background, she can't go to school with her brother.
"Sit down, are you scared?"
The woman's friendly attitude made Shen Zhi feel a little uncomfortable.
"Let me ask you, what's going on with Tianbian?" Shen Zhi was even more curious about the identity of the woman in front of him who claimed to have been a classmate of his brother for two years. What camp? What position?
The woman said: "What do you think?"
Shen Zhi: "..."
Seeing the young man's vague expression of sullenness, the woman smiled and said, "Your reaction is very similar to your brother's. I just want to tease you. All the internal agents we deployed in Tenbenji captured the city without much effort. After entering the city, everything was fine."
The scene that Shen Zhi was worried about didn't happen.
"In other words, you are with the rebels?"
The woman was not happy to hear this word and poured herself a cup of tea: "Young man, don't be so angry. Tell me, what is a rebel? What is a king's master? The royal family is unruly, the people are ignorant, causing chaos, and the people are living in dire straits..."
"Speaking of Potian, you are also rebellious officials and traitors."
Shen Zhi doesn't like women.
He has his own criteria for judging.
